SELECT t1.CORP_GR , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.FUND_CD , t1.TRUSTEE , t1.JM_CD , t1.CURRENCY , t1.TR_BFIL_JUSU + COALESCE(t1.RIGHT_JUSU, 0) AS tr_bfil_jusu , t1.TR_UP_JUSU , t1.TR_DW_JUSU , t1.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK + COALESCE(t1.RIGHT_AEK, 0) AS tr_bfil_chui_aek , t1.TR_UP_CHUI_AEK , t1.TR_DW_CHUI_AEK , t1.TR_PYUNGA_AEK , t1.FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK + COALESCE(t1.RIGHT_FCUR_AEK, 0) AS fcur_bfil_chui_aek , t1.FCUR_UP_CHUI_AEK , t1.FCUR_DW_CHUI_AEK , t1.WON_BFIL_CHUI_AEK + COALESCE(t1.RIGHT_WON_AEK, 0) AS won_bfil_chui_aek , t1.WON_UP_CHUI_AEK , t1.WON_DW_CHUI_AEK , t1.BFIL_SUNG_COST , t1.SUNG_COST , t1.FCUR_BFIL_SUNG_COST , t1.FCUR_SUNG_COST , t1.WON_BFIL_SUNG_COST , t1.WON_SUNG_COST , t1.BFIL_MISU_IJA , t1.MISU_IJA , t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK , t1.FCUR_PYUNGA_SONIK , t1.FCUR_HWAN_CHA , t1.WON_PYUNGA_AEK , t1.WON_PYUNGA_SONIK , t1.WON_HWAN_CHA , ya.JM_NM , ya.JASAN_GB , F_SZX0GR('62', ya.JASAN_GB) AS jasan_nm , ia.FUND_NM , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , t1.BS_TYPE , t1.SM_TR_GB , ia.FUND_CURRENCY FROM SYM0YZ t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SYM0YA ya ON ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD INNER JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD = TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{ymd}, '[^0-9]', ''), 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD')
AND ia.FUND_CURRENCY <> 'KRW'
AND ia.FUND_CURRENCY = 'KRW'
ORDER BY ya.JASAN_GB ASC , t1.FUND_CD ASC , t1.CURRENCY ASC , t1.JM_CD ASC
